description: Run one image or video card from get_task: this spends the workspace credits, so ask your human first, naming the card and its price. Refused when the price is no longer accept_price or the card now leaves out other images; read get_task again without seen then. The result lands in the task roll; poll get_task for files.

accept_price.description: The card price your human agreed to; null when get_task shows no price (set when it runs).

card.description: A card id from get_task cards.

left_out.description: The card's left_out image ids, as get_task listed them.

name: generate
